changelog:
Initial release of x402 Budget Manager.

- Enforces per-endpoint hard/soft caps and pre-authorized override budgets for x402 requests.
- Supports two enforcement modes: per-request (stateless, default) and cumulative session (stateful).
- Implements global and per-provider monthly and session spend ceilings.
- Reads pricing before each call; aborts or escalates requests based on configurable budget.json policy.
- Tracks cumulative spend in an append-only spend log for auditability and enforcement.
- Prevents overspend and unapproved payments, making x402 clients production-safe.
summary: Track and cap x402 spend across providers — per-endpoint hard_cap/soft_cap, pre-authorized override budgets, cumulative spend tracking, monthly ceilings. Makes x402 the client production-safe by preventing overspend and aborting costly calls before they happen.
